dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, thin, white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against dark gray-blue plumage.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale gray-blue edges are visible along the folded primary and secondary feathers, providing sharp linear definition against darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly triangular yellowish patch is visible on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear boundary separates the solid black crown from the yellowish nape and gray-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white auricular patch (cheek) bordered by black plumage on the crown and throat.
